```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- Parameter entity comment -->">
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity Content">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  %pe;
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Primary catalog comment section -->
  <?target-pi processing instruction value?>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like text: <item>&ent;</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Root Entity">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base; Extended">
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Outer document comment -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with entities: &ref;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_ent "<!ENTITY hidden 'SecretValue'>">
  %local_ent;
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.net/inv" xmlns:custom="http://example.net/custom">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <?inventory-mgmt status="active"?>
  <custom:product>
    <![CDATA[
      Product description &hidden; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </custom:product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY section.title "Default Title">
  <!ENTITY % ext_subset "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext_subset;
]>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Document structure comment -->
  <?xml-hip-target action="validate"?>
  <section xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Section CDATA content &section.title;
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY e_beta "&e_alpha; Beta">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc_pdf SYSTEM "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://example.com/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.com/metadata">
  <!-- Archive description and layout comment -->
  <?archive-engine version="1.0"?>
  <meta:record>
    <![CDATA[
      Archive record CDATA payload: &e_beta;
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
</archive>
```
